events.ai_basis: Exceptions to this fixed procedure include work on a zero-free region for the Riemann zeta function and proof of the Hodge Conjecture for CM abelian varieties.

why: GRH asks that every nontrivial zero of every Dirichlet L-function lie on Re s = 1/2. Nothing after the snapshot settles that or any named part of it. Zero-free half-planes (7/8, 11/12), the uniform Siegel-zero gap, and the lower bounds on the proportion of zeros that are simple and on the line (Alpöge–Furman Theorem B, Hua–Yang, Johns, and the zeta-only Lamzouri and Knausgård papers) all move a quantity while leaving the question open, so they are bounds. A proof of RH alone would be a case, because the trivial character is one named restriction. The OpenAI and Anthropic work credits the model with producing the mathematics, so it is generated. Lamzouri's AxiomProver use is formalisation, so it is none, and Knausgård has no system credited with mathematics. Conrey and Goldston's examination is reported only by Anthropic, so it is not public digestion. Full GRH claims are knocked down (Agélas, through Brent's identified false lemma) or not credible (Zhang). Blinovsky dropped his own GRH claim. The crank RH claims carry several F10 signals each. Conditional, moment and value-distribution papers are variants, and the Lu–Zaman–Zhao computation is instances.
doubts: openai-math-003 duplicates oi-003-7-8 and oi-003-11-12 (and includes the Siegel Lean statement), so they are one release counted three or four times. All of them are bounds, so the duplication does not change the arithmetic. The README's exception for 'a zero-free region for the Riemann zeta function' may mean humans had a larger hand in the 7/8 or 11/12 work than the general quote implies, but nothing in the record supports reducing it below generated. An unconditional uniform Siegel-zero gap and a quasi-RH would be landmark claims. I left them credible because Lean theorem names are listed and nothing specific is wrong, but they are unchecked. The Zhang date of 2025 is year-only but clearly falls after January 2024.
